# Sloan Financial Solutions

> Locally owned financial planning and tax practice founded in 2020 by David Sloan, with offices in Burnsville, Minnesota and Barron, Wisconsin, serving clients in person and by video, including the Milwaukee area.

Securities and investment advisory services are offered through Geneos Wealth Management, Inc., Member FINRA/SIPC. Tax services are offered separately through Sloan Financial Solutions LLC.

## Services
- [Financial planning](https://www.sloanfs.com/financial-planning): holistic planning, Roth IRAs, 401(k) rollovers, tax planning, 529 and UTMA accounts, estate planning.
- [Tax services](https://www.sloanfs.com/tax-services): tax preparation for individuals and businesses, tax planning, bookkeeping, Bookkeeping Plus (outsourced CFO).

## Locations
- [Burnsville, MN](https://www.sloanfs.com/burnsville-mn): 12301 Nicollet Ave, Suite 101, Burnsville, MN 55337. (952) 432-8000. Serves Apple Valley, Eagan, Savage, Prior Lake, Lakeville, Shakopee.
- [Barron, WI](https://www.sloanfs.com/barron-wi): 421 E La Salle Ave, Suite A, Barron, WI 54812. (715) 418-2044. Serves Rice Lake, Cameron, Chetek, Spooner, Cumberland, Hayward.
- [Milwaukee area](https://www.sloanfs.com/milwaukee-wi): by video and phone. Serves Milwaukee, New Berlin, Muskego, Franklin, Brookfield, West Allis.
